critical_scientific_question: Did old serialized provider response raw-SHA mismatches reflect transient metadata serialization, or physical changes in UTC-hourly four-field ERA5 values? Without archived old weather numeric arrays the old-vs-now physical-equivalence question cannot be answered; we can independently test now-vs-now reproducibility and freeze a newly versioned physical array.

measurement.raw_response_sha256: SHA256 unmodified raw HTTP JSON payload. Sensitive to dynamic generationtime_ms, metadata order and byte formatting.
measurement.physical_response_sha256: SHA256 canonical representation of YEAR UTC hour labels + exact variable names/units + decimal numeric payloads at 1e-6 resolution and missing cells. Stable to whitespace, JSON key ordering, int/float numeric formatting, generationtime_ms and unconsumed metadata.
measurement.physical_metadata_check: In addition to numerical hash comparison, flag physical grid metadata change separately. Do not coerce a new returned model grid to prior actual animal location.
measurement.within_same_session_replication: Two independently requested identical parameter sets within the same run, 1-second separation. Compare raw and canonical SHA and per-variable changed hours. Do not infer the old archived physical values.
measurement.gap_limits: Request cap 6 MB / calendar full-year only; every provider source hold remains explicit and no original GPX coordinates/year included in output.

original_GPS_preflight: For Utah and Wyoming source packets, require original bitstream UUID, size and MD5, then replay native q / daylight source means and counts to tolerance 1e-12 BEFORE choosing the original top-two q-coverage gridyears and requesting ERA5.
original_context_selection: Use unchanged source-original q support top 2; verify original taxon context ranks, original qday and eligible animal counts against v0 before querying. No favorable new climate/version/animal sign selection.
new_physical_snapshot_policy: New physical SHA is a NEW provider-version provenance, not a retroactive proof old v0 ERA5 arrays were identical. Do not reclassify any original biological shortwave effects or 12 holds.
privacy: Do not store GPS source gridcenter/year, original tagged IDs, tracks, UTC animal fix times, per-animal GPS/ERA5 effects, raw provider JSON or request URL for tracked animals. Benchmark public lat/lon fixed independent of GPS sources and permitted.
next_biology_route: Only after source-specific canonical hourly physical fingerprints are available and a new original GPS/animal/step eligibility contract is separately frozen can new weather/heading models be explored. Compare with original v0 as explicit reanalysis of a different version, not independent confirmation.
